name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 34h screen at 00E198AC+5Ch, the smallest of the seven. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CF170C at +00h and 00CF16F8 at +08h, and zeroes +18h..+30h. Slot +00h of 00CF170C is 005CA8E0, a 'mov eax,2; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 2 = INTF_MISSIONTREE. Its register override 005CAAF0 reads Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua through the keys multiMissionInfos and missionGroups and reports progress through BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress; there is no GUI layout in the class, so this holds the mission-tree data rather than a page. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_GetScreenId
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Five bytes: 'mov eax,2; ret'. Slot +00h of vtable 00CF170C, the registry index 004F71D0 uses. 2 is INTF_MISSIONTREE in the 00E08CD8 table, which agrees with the class's Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MultiChatScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this), RET, SEH frame handler 00C73898, primary vtable slot +10h of 00CF1998. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0), then BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate (004C12B0) with the pooled literal _Chat, stores the 00AA5840 handle at +3Ch, clears the bytes at +8Ch and +8Dh and calls virtual +14h last. docs/MULTI_MENU_SCREENS.md

name: BSP_MultiChatScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this) -> this in EAX, RET, SEH frame handler 00C73A69. The only one of the six with two vtables rather than three and the only one that chains a second base constructor (00A97260) after 004F7180: vtable 00CF1998 at +00h and 00CF19C0 at +08h. Then 005CEE20 fills +6Ch and 005CEE40 fills +78h and +84h, each followed by a cleared dword. 90h bytes, stored at manager 00E198B4+54h; 00772083 reads that slot to reach the chat screen. Vtable slot +00h is 005CFE40 'mov eax,15h; ret'. Screen id 15h is not a target of 00687330, so no interface request selects it: it is an overlay the other multiplayer screens drive. Its register virtual 005CF260 binds the GUI page _Chat at +3Ch. docs/MULTI_MENU_SCREENS.md
